methods.label: Scale both fruit quantities together
methods.explanation:
Equivalent fruit quantities scale together: multiplying the number of bananas by a factor multiplies the equivalent number of oranges by the same factor. The given banana quantity is
\[
\frac23\cdot10=\frac{20}{3},
\]
and the requested quantity is \(\frac12\cdot5=\frac52\) bananas. The requested quantity is the following fraction of the given one:
\[
\frac52\div\frac{20}{3}
=\frac52\cdot\frac3{20}
=\frac38.
\]
Thus its equivalent orange quantity is \(8\cdot\frac38=3\). The answer is \(3\) oranges, choice \(C\).
